transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Hi, can tell me about the layout? Need a room for work from home.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Hi! Pearl Residences Phase 1 has a 900 sq. ft. layout with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. One of the bedrooms could be used as a work-from-home room. Do you need a separate enclosed room for work?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Yes, ideally enclosed, since I’m on calls quite often. But it’d be good if the room could still be used for something else when needed.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: That makes sense—an enclosed room would give you privacy for calls while staying flexible for other uses. I’ll check the floor plan before confirming whether the layout can accommodate that.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Thanks. It’s for my own stay—actually, my mum may stay over more often, so a flexible room for her is becoming more important than a dedicated office. Would the layout work for that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: I haven’t been able to verify the floor plan yet, so I can’t confirm the fit. I’d want to check the room’s layout and dimensions before advising whether it would work for both your mum’s stays and your calls.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Okay, please check the room dimensions if you can. I’d need it to fit a single bed for my mum and still be usable as a quiet workspace when she’s not staying over.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Thanks, I’ll check the floor plan and room dimensions before advising whether it can fit a single bed and still work as a quiet workspace.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Thanks. Also, do you know if the maintenance fee includes clubhouse use, or is that charged separately?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: The maintenance fee is RM0.18 per sq. ft., inclusive of the sinking fund. Selected clubhouse facilities are pay-per-use, so they’re not covered by that fee.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Got it, thanks. Do you know the pay-per-use rates for the clubhouse? And any update on the room dimensions for fitting a single bed?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: I don’t have verified rates or room dimensions yet, so I can’t confirm either. I’ll check the current clubhouse pay-per-use rates and the floor-plan dimensions for the single-bed and workspace setup.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Thanks, please check. Just to clarify, are only selected clubhouse facilities pay-per-use, with any others included in the maintenance fee? A list of the facilities and rates would help me compare the ongoing costs for my own stay.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: The maintenance fee is RM0.18 per sq. ft., including the sinking fund, and selected clubhouse facilities are pay-per-use. I can’t confirm which other facilities are included or the current rates yet, so I’ll check the itemised list. I’ll also follow up on the room dimensions you asked about.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Okay, thanks. Please send the itemised clubhouse list and rates, and the room dimensions once you’ve checked. I’d like to be clear on what’s included versus extra before I work out the ongoing costs.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Understood—you need the itemised clubhouse inclusions and current rates, as well as the room dimensions, to compare the costs and layout. I don’t have those details verified yet, so I’ll confirm them and send them together rather than guess.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Thanks. Do you know roughly when you might have those details? I’d rather wait for confirmed info before estimating the costs.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: I don’t have a reliable timeframe yet, so I don’t want to guess. I’ll check and update you once I can confirm the itemised clubhouse inclusions and rates, along with the room dimensions.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: I don’t have a confirmed timeframe yet, so I can’t give you a reliable estimate. I’ll request confirmation and share it once I have it, together with the itemised clubhouse charges and room dimensions.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.message: Okay, but I’m still not clear on the clubhouse part—does the maintenance fee include general access, with only certain facilities charged, or is clubhouse access itself pay-per-use? I can wait for the full list, but that distinction matters.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: You’re right—the distinction matters. I can’t confirm whether general clubhouse access is included in the maintenance fee or whether access itself is pay-per-use. I can only confirm that selected facilities are pay-per-use; that doesn’t clarify general access. I’ll check the access policy along with the itemised inclusions and current rates before you estimate the costs.
